import re

def parse(lines):
    fans = []; fl = []
    temps = []; tl = []
    psu = []; pl = []
    rps = []; rl = []
    skip = []
    sw = ''
    sysst = ''
    cur = None
    mode = None
    hdr = []
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if re.match(r'^\S+#', s):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^Switch (\d+) FAN (\S+) is (.+)$', s)
        if m:
            sw = m.group(1)
            fans.append({'Switch': sw, 'Fan': m.group(2), 'Status': m.group(3)})
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^FAN (\S+) is (.+)$', s)
        if m:
            fans.append({'Switch': sw, 'Fan': m.group(1), 'Status': m.group(2)})
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^Switch (\d+): SYSTEM TEMPERATURE is (.+)$', s)
        if m:
            sw = m.group(1)
            sysst = m.group(2)
            tl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(.+?) Temperature Value\s*:\s*(.+)$', s)
        if m:
            cur = {'Switch': sw, 'System Temperature': sysst, 'Sensor': m.group(1), 'Value': m.group(2), 'State': '', 'Yellow Threshold': '', 'Red Threshold': ''}
            temps.append(cur)
            tl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^Temperature State\s*:\s*(.+)$', s)
        if m and cur is not None:
            cur['State'] = m.group(1)
            tl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^(Yellow|Red) Threshold\s*:\s*(.+)$', s)
        if m and cur is not None:
            cur[m.group(1) + ' Threshold'] = m.group(2)
            tl.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^-+(\s+-+)+$', s):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^SW\s', s) and 'PID' in s:
            mode = 'psu'
            hdr = re.split(r'\s{2,}', s)
            pl.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^SW\s', s) and 'RPS' in s:
            mode = 'rps'
            hdr = re.split(r'\s{2,}', s)
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        if mode:
            f = re.split(r'\s{2,}', s)
            row = {h: '' for h in hdr}
            if mode == 'psu' and len(f) == 2 and 'Status' in row:
                row[hdr[0]] = f[0]
                row['Status'] = f[1]
            else:
                for k in range(min(len(f), len(hdr))):
                    row[hdr[k]] = f[k]
                if len(f) > len(hdr):
                    row[hdr[-1]] = '  '.join(f[len(hdr) - 1:])
            if mode == 'psu':
                psu.append(row); pl.append(i)
            else:
                rps.append(row); rl.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if fans:
        blocks.append({'name': 'fans', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': fl, 'records': fans})
    if temps or tl:
        blocks.append({'name': 'temperatures', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': tl, 'records': temps})
    if pl:
        blocks.append({'name': 'power_supplies', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': pl, 'records': psu})
    if rl:
        blocks.append({'name': 'rps', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': rl, 'records': rps})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
